name: Touyama Kouji
source:
"What's up? I'm Kouji Touyama. I'm a somewhat well-known character... I... I said somewhat, okay? It's not weird if you've never heard of me. My daughter, Mai? Ah, that girl... she's scary. We live separately now. Hey! I haven't done anything wrong, alright?!"

The father of [url=/c160574]Mai[/url] and [url=/c160630]Sanae[/url]. He pushed his way into marriage with his wife, a painter, by saying they shared art in common.

Unlike his wife, who specializes in abstract art, he focuses exclusively on 2D anime-style girls. After the company he worked for went bankrupt, he lost motivation and became a hopeless slob, ending up estranged from his entire family.

That said, he did help get Mai a job at Iris Corporation, so it seems he's not completely cut off. Still, Mai wants nothing to do with him and seems to actively avoid him. There are even rumors that she once tried to kill him...?

He's as rough as he looks, but he's nice to people who flatter him. Thankfully, both Iris Corporation and [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] figured out how to deal with him easily enough...

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category1&ch=koji]official website[/url]]
